items.title: Remove green-waste deposits from municipal land
items.quote: Ich fordere Sie gemäß § 14 OBG NRW auf, die Ablagerungen bis zum 20.01.2026 vollständig zu beseitigen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for compliance: 20.01.2026. No period calculation is needed; this is the last day named in the order itself.

items.title: File Klage with the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Die Klage muss binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe des Bescheids schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 23.12.2025, sent by ordinary post. Under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG an authority letter posted domestically is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: Sat 27.12.2025 (this day does not shift merely for delivery-fiction purposes). Counting of the one-month period starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Tue 27.01.2026. That day is a business day (not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday), so no further shift applies (§ 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG). Final day to have the Klage received by the court: 27.01.2026.

warnings: The €480.00 is only the estimated cost of a future Ersatzvornahme (substitute performance) that would be charged only if the deadline of 20.01.2026 is missed; it is not a payment currently due.

This is a formal administrative order (Ordnungsverfügung) with a one-month Klage deadline directly to the Verwaltungsgericht (no Widerspruch stage) — get advice (e.g. a lawyer or Verbraucherzentrale) well before 27.01.2026 if you intend to contest it.

The exact delivery date of the letter is assumed from the printed document date (23.12.2025) plus the statutory 4-day fiction; if the letter was actually posted later or the person can show later actual receipt, the one-month Klage deadline could fall later than 27.01.2026 — verify the actual postmark/receipt date if in doubt.
